scope: Statuses apply to the stated subset, not to the complete architecture. Verification and build-option evidence are recorded separately.

facilities.subset: Explicit linked-v2 analyzer selection with canonical verified MIR snapshots, capability-scoped registration, and validated transactional diagnostics.
blockers: No dynamic ABI-2 or worker activation; no PPX-v2, transform or backend facet in this profile.

facilities.subset: Opt-in host-authorized loading of a sealed, digest-pinned native image on Linux/glibc. Trusted host-process execution, not an isolation facility.
blockers: Compiler-generated modules, attestation of native dependencies, non-Linux targets.

facilities.subset: Frozen ABI 1 layouts and status values 0–7; copied registry metadata, transaction rollback and synchronous source or verified-MIR hooks.
Prefix negotiation, shared contracts, allocator domains, generation handles, bounded diagnostics and budgets, cancellation and monotonic deadlines.
Transactional ABI 2 dependency registration with capability intersection, reverse compensation, immutable views and bounded canonical MuLIB CDD planning.
blockers: Exact CDD planner profile is limited to 64 entries.

facilities.subset: ABI 1 DSO callbacks for serialized verified MIR on the explicitly selected Linux x86-64 worker path; isolation setup is fail-closed.
blockers: Requires host isolation support and a compatible worker; no unsupported-platform fallback.

facilities.subset: Inert manifest discovery, host trust and digest authorization, capability-scoped tables, bounded protocol 2 and a digest-checked data plane.
blockers: The CLI legacy hook path is not a general ABI 2 extension activation driver.
The System V mapping transport does not provide kernel sealing.
No WASM engine or cross-platform sandbox.

facilities.subset: Thread-confined canonical frontend sessions, immutable sources, normalized VFS/workspaces, dependency snapshots, incremental refresh and exact-revision cache keys.
blockers: Frontend object allocation is SDK-owned; custom compiler-session allocators are not supported.

facilities.subset: Canonical scanners, token/AST visitors, source maps, macro and hygiene data, PPX-v1 candidate readmission and revision-checked source edits.
blockers: The frontend API does not publish checked HIR or perform semantic staging lowering.
No PPX-v2 transport.

facilities.subset: Immutable canonical type handles, child/label and kind queries, verification, equality and forall-instance tests. Typed CSP payloads and endpoint cardinalities use explicit wire mapping.
blockers: Legacy untyped endpoint wire values 33/34 reject explicitly.
No general public inference, unification, layout, borrow or constraint solver.

facilities.subset: Revision-bound canonical checked-HIR views, scalar/numeric verified MIR and evaluator, candidate-only wire decode and rollback-capable MIR transactions.
blockers: Inspected wire HIR cannot be promoted.
Host-only publication; no general aggregate, resource or effectful MIR coverage.

facilities.subset: Revision-bound canonical MIR v1–v3 CFG, dominators, loops, SSA liveness and effect analysis; bounded options and cache.
blockers: No general alias, points-to or symbolic analyses.
Optional Novostone covers a narrow MIR-v1 subset; see verification for packaging scope.

facilities.subset: Bounded built-in pipeline DSL, instrumentation, rollback, declared preservation checks, candidate bytes and scalar invocation evidence.
blockers: Not a general equivalence proof, arbitrary rewrite engine or independent publication API.

facilities.subset: Five canonical built-in adapters, explicit capabilities and target matching, bounded staged artifacts with digest/reproducibility checks, and host-authorized inert toolchain resolution.
blockers: No verified direct machine-code pipeline, native JIT or general cross-target ABI.
Toolchain resolution does not execute tools or search PATH.

facilities.subset: Structured CDecl/contract projections, checked one-TU CDD accessors and explicit host review/boundary evidence for scalar, immutable C-string and restricted opaque handle profiles.
blockers: No admission from ABI 1 metadata or extraction alone.
General marshalling, retained foreign callbacks, dynamic loader and in-process binding generation are unsupported.

facilities.subset: Independent On1xRT ABI 1 for explicitly host-authorized native AOT and statically registered modules, bounded lifecycle, scalar/string/buffer calls and synchronous host callbacks.
blockers: Trusted Linux/glibc dynamic loading is a separate opt-in profile. No WASM, public task/channel scheduler, debugger, profiler or sandbox enforcement. Native callbacks have process authority.

facilities.subset: Declarative On1xfile subset, deterministic graph and digests, offline host-supplied resolution, and bounded process requests dispatched only by host callbacks.
blockers: No template or policy execution through the manifest API, network fetch or implicit process execution.

facilities.subset: Data-only on1x-sdk CLI including explicit on1xc dispatch, project formatting, authorized compiler formatting/catalogue calls and revision-bound LSP candidate actions.
blockers: No public semantic index and no SDK completion, rename, REPL, debugging or profiling service.

facilities.subset: C++17 RAII and CPython ctypes for the implemented project subset.
blockers: Python allocator uses POSIX posix_memalign; other language bindings are not shipped.

facilities.subset: On1x-authored value modules and reference analyzer emitted by canonical on1xc to C11, using an explicitly trusted static scalar bridge.
blockers: No general reviewed native host-table binding, dynamic worker/DSO loading, sandbox, cross-compiled host reference or structured compiler snapshot access.

facilities.subset: SDK 2.0.0 CMake package, independent C11/C++17 headers, project shared library, compiler support, provenance reports and separate runtime package.
